Key imported rows on date, amount and normalized payee

importRows keyed each row on its raw export line.
A bank export that listed one payment with the payee "Coffee Shop" and again
with " coffee shop " produced two keys, so the payment was imported twice.

The key is now the row's date, its amount formatted with toFixed(2) and its
payee trimmed and lowercased.
Rows that differ only in payee case, spaces around the payee or float noise
past the second decimal now count as one payment.

New tests cover the payee case, the amount rounding and rows that differ in
date, amount or payee.
